entities.name: Élmer Mendoza
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Élmer Mendoza is a Mexican author. He is one of the key figures in the genre known as narcoliterature. A dramatist and short story writer, he is known above all for his novels, several of which feature the detective Edgar El Zurdo Mendieta.
